title: Enhanced thermal management in CO2 methanation using spiral-structured catalysts: a comparative study with honeycomb, monolith, and packed-bed systems
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,4974-4988
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00718F, Paper
Ryo Watanabe, Shota Ueda, Hiroshi Akama, Kazuhide Mino, Choji Fukuhara
Catalytic performance of four structured catalysts was evaluated under a 2 L min−1 flow rate. The spiral-structured catalyst exhibited the highest CO₂ conversion and stable CH₄ selectivity, owing to superior flow distribution and thermal control.
